newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunkers gain a further $1, fair demand.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers gain a further $1, fair demand.

text.p: Rotterdam bunkers ticked up by another $1 a tonne on Friday in reasonable demand, while prices elsewhere in Europe changed little, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST fuel oil bunkers were quoted in the range $91/$92 fob as barges moved up to as high as $90 ex wharf.
Suppliers said total ARA volume was in excess of 15,000 tonnes. Some estimated the level at more than 20,000 tonnes.
"Certainly for a Friday, it's been pretty good. It built up steadily through through the afternoon," one supplier said.
Hamburg prices were broadly steady with low demand.
Mediterranean fuel oil bunkers were steady while gas oil rose by $2 a tonne in most places.
In Greece, fuel oil prices rose by $1 with continuing tightness of supply due to refinery maintenance.
